summary: Public Service Enterprise Group Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $500 million offering of 4.800% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes are unsecured, rank equally with other senior unsecured debt, and are not listed on any exchange. The offering is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. There is no price per share, premium, or acquisition context. Proceeds before expenses are $496,305,000. The filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
